home.headline: Find your
home.lede: American Legion Gaming uses gaming, esports, and online community to connect veterans, servicemembers, Legion Family members, and supporters.
home.questionAriaLabel: What brings you to American Legion Gaming?
home.yesDetail: Games, competition, events, and shared experiences.
home.noDetail: Connection, support, or a path into gaming and technology.
home.touchNote: Choose the doorway that sounds useful
home.missionMeta: Internal demo · not an official ALG product

mission.yesTitle: How would you like to play?
mission.yesPrompt: Choose every kind of experience that sounds good.
mission.noPrompt: Pick the first doorway you would want to explore.
mission.yesChoiceAriaLabel: Choose American Legion Gaming play experiences
mission.noChoiceAriaLabel: Choose an American Legion Gaming support doorway

choices.label: Online play
choices.detail: Find teammates, join community events, and keep the connection going from home.
choices.outcomeTitle: Your squad does not need to live nearby.
choices.outcomeBody: Online community gives veterans and servicemembers a shared place to play, talk, and stay connected across distance.

choices.label: Live events
choices.detail: Free play, tournaments, racing, retro games, and a reason to gather in person.
choices.outcomeTitle: The game can become the gathering place.
choices.outcomeBody: American Legion Gaming has used gaming lounges and event activations to make connection immediate, social, and welcoming.

choices.label: Connection
choices.detail: A modern community for camaraderie, shared experiences, and finding people who understand.
choices.outcomeTitle: Connection is one of the pillars.
choices.outcomeBody: Gaming creates an easy first activity, but the larger goal is a community where relationships can grow online and in person.

choices.label: Careers
choices.detail: Explore education and work in gaming, technology, cybersecurity, and digital spaces.
choices.outcomeTitle: A shared interest can point toward a future.
choices.outcomeBody: The Careers pillar connects interest in games and technology with resources, education, and professional possibilities.

completion.fallbackTitle: There is a place to begin.
completion.fallbackBody: American Legion Gaming uses familiar interests to create comfort, connection, and new possibilities.
completion.multiTitle: Play can open more than one door.
completion.multiBody: Online community and live events can reinforce one another—the relationship can begin anywhere.
completion.promotionalLine: Find your squad. Build what comes next.
completion.realizationTitle: Start with what would help today.
completion.realizationBody: Connection and careers do not sit outside the gaming mission. They are part of why the community exists.
completion.nonGamerTitle: You do not need to compete to belong.
completion.nonGamerBody: People can participate through community, service, mentorship, events, technical work, and support roles.
completion.nonGamerPromotionalLine: The mission is larger than the match.

discovery.title: Three pillars. One community.
discovery.prompt: Choose the part of American Legion Gaming you would like to understand first.
discovery.choiceAriaLabel: Choose an American Legion Gaming pillar
discovery.qrAlt: QR code for the American Legion Gaming website

items.label: Comfort
items.summary: Play, recreation, and room to breathe.
items.title: Sometimes the useful thing is a place to exhale.
items.lead: Games can provide recreation, focus, and a shared activity during stressful or isolating seasons.
items.factTitle: Comfort includes recreation and mental well-being.
items.factBody: American Legion Gaming describes Comfort as using games for recreation, stress reduction, and support against isolation.
items.humanTitle: A low-pressure activity can make room for people.
items.humanBody: Nobody has to begin with a heavy conversation. Playing alongside someone can be enough for the first visit.
items.sourceLabel: Internal demo content adapted from the public ALG mission at algvets.org.

items.label: Connection
items.summary: Relationships built online and in person.
items.title: The squad is the lasting part.
items.lead: Shared games and events give veterans and servicemembers an immediate reason to interact.
items.factTitle: Connection bridges digital and physical communities.
items.factBody: ALG describes gaming as a modern tool for camaraderie, recruitment, veteran support, and community building.
items.humanTitle: The first conversation already has a subject.
items.humanBody: A match, race, tournament, or community event can replace an awkward introduction with something people can do together.
items.sourceLabel: Internal demo content adapted from public ALG and American Legion reporting.

items.label: Careers
items.summary: Turn digital interests into practical possibilities.
items.title: Gaming and technology contain more roles than most people see.
items.lead: Interest in games can lead toward education, technical skills, cybersecurity, content, events, and other work.
items.factBody: ALG says its Careers pillar helps veterans explore education and employment in gaming, technology, and digital spaces.
items.humanTitle: A hobby can reveal an overlooked strength.
items.humanBody: Teamwork, systems thinking, communication, production, and technical curiosity can become starting points for a new direction.
items.sourceLabel: Internal demo content adapted from the public ALG mission at algvets.org.
